name_hi: भिंडी का तना और फल छेदक (इरियास)
symptoms_en: Terminal shoots wither and droop; buds and flowers drop; fruits have bore holes and are deformed.
symptoms_hi: सिरे की कोंपलें मुरझाकर झुक जाती हैं; कलियाँ और फूल झड़ते हैं; फलों में छेद होते हैं और वे बेढंगे हो जाते हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of bendi
symptoms_en.quote: Terminal shoots wither and droop Shedding of buds and flowers Bore hole in fruits and fee Deformed fruits

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of bendi
management_en.quote: Set up pheromone trap @ 12/ha. Collection and destruction of affected fruits. Release of egg parasite Trichogramma chilonis @ 1.0 lakh/ha.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Borer, Fall Armyworm, and Fruit Fly control: Spray Agniastra @ 3 litres / 100 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Set pheromone traps (12 per hectare). Collect and destroy affected fruits. Release the egg parasite Trichogramma chilonis (1 lakh per hectare).
management_hi: फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएँ (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर)। प्रभावित फल इकट्ठा करके नष्ट करें। अंडा परजीवी ट्राइकोग्रामा किलोनिस (1 लाख प्रति हेक्टेयर) छोड़ें।
source_notes: AI research (2026-10-07). Organic and cultural steps only are listed under management; chemical sprays in the sources are left out. Escalation advice is not sourced yet (TODO(agronomist)).
